notes.title: Save Update
notes.content:
SAVE feature in Charlotte
Saving in Charlotte will only save general game information and allow you to load faster. It will not save the position of the doors and you will start again in the library. It DOES allow you to skip all the intro scenes and improve game loading time.

We have just pushed an update that shouldsolve the issues of system lock up when loading/saving. however, if you have any issues, please post in this discussion and we will try to resolve any issues. Thank you for your patience!

notes.title: Charlotte Update
notes.content: Charlotte has been updated to correct the SteamVR issue. In the older version, the game would launch in SteamVR if you had a headset attached to your computer.
